description: This file declares the class USBDeviceImplementation which implements the IUSBDevice interface for managing USB devices, including hotplug events, device info retrieval, and driver binding/unbinding. It contains class definitions, method declarations, and macro definitions related to USB device handling within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: USBDeviceImplementation
classes.description: Implements the IUSBDevice interface, manages USB device hotplug events, device information, and driver binding within the WPEFramework plugin system.

classes.name: USBDeviceImplementation::Job
classes.description: Represents a dispatched job for handling USB device events asynchronously.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for USB device events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback for USB device events.

methods.name: GetDeviceList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of connected USB devices.

methods.name: GetDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific USB device by name.

methods.name: BindDriver
methods.description: Binds a driver to a specified USB device.

methods.name: UnbindDriver
methods.description: Unbinds a driver from a specified USB device.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Internal method to dispatch a USB device event to registered notifications.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Handles the dispatching of a USB device event.

methods.name: libUSBInit
methods.description: Initializes the libusb context.

methods.name: libUSBClose
methods.description: Closes the libusb context.

methods.name: getUSBDevicClassFromInterfaceDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the device class and subclass from a device interface descriptor.

methods.name: getDevicePathFromDevice
methods.description: Gets the device path and serial number from a libusb device.

methods.name: getDeviceSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number of a USB device.

methods.name: getUSBDescriptorValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string descriptor value from a device handle.

methods.name: getUSBExtInfoStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Extracts extended info from a device descriptor.

methods.name: getUSBDeviceInfoStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Extracts device info from a device descriptor.

methods.name: getUSBDeviceStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Constructs a USBDevice structure from a device descriptor.

methods.name: libUSBHotPlugCallbackDeviceAttached
methods.description: Callback invoked when a USB device is attached.

methods.name: libUSBHotPlugCallbackDeviceDetached
methods.description: Callback invoked when a USB device is detached.

methods.name: libUSBEventsHandlingThread
methods.description: Thread function to handle libusb events.
